reasoning: Vermont does not have a 2026 U.S. Senate general-election race on the ballot; the relevant available 2026 polling in the last 45 days is for governor, not Senate, so there is no current Senate margin to report from state-specific polling. The most relevant recent statewide poll shows Phil Scott leading in the governor’s race by double digits, while Vermont’s statewide Cook PVI remains strongly Democratic at D+26.

sources.name: University of New Hampshire Survey Center
sources.details: Statewide UNH Survey Center polling found Phil Scott ahead in the 2026 Vermont governor matchup by 8 points over Rebecca Holcombe and by 11 points over Esther Charlestin in separate ballot tests.
